owner_decision: 7 November 2026: publish MoEdern 27M/115M Q4_K_MIX as EXPERIMENTAL; SciFact retrieval and public-client panels are not measured and are stated as such on the card.

Q4_K_MIX.note: Q8_0 base; routed-expert up/down projections and attn_q Q4_K (zero-padded 640->768 columns); gate experts, shared experts and attn_k/v/o Q8_0; embeddings, router, norms and dense head F32. 30.53 MiB vs 35.67 MiB Q8_0.
Q4_K_MIX.build_note: Built from the policy's recipe string, i.e. the exact x86 arm measured in run 41618191791; its moedern.q4k.policy metadata therefore reads q8+exps_up+exps_down+attn_q (the recipe of moedern27m_q4k_v1).

Q4_K_MIX.note: All 52 engine-quantizable matmul weights Q4_K (640-wide rows zero-padded to 768); embeddings, router, norms, depthwise conv kernels and dense head F32. 85.34 MiB vs 134.55 MiB Q8_0.

not_qualified.1.5M: no Q4_K recipe clears 0.94 and Q4_K cannot be smaller than Q8_0 (128-wide rows)
not_qualified.Q8_0: named Q8_0 fails the 0.97 bar on 27M (0.9315) and 115M (0.9670) through single-token routing flips

open: Retrieval (SciFact NDCG/MRR/Recall, top-1 agreement), public-client panels and GPU are not measured for a quantized package; strict 0.002/0.99999 vector budgets are not met. Published as experimental by owner decision.
